description: Development-workflow AI assistant scenarios. Score golden pass/fail answers and optional drafts. User-facing assistants are TASK-094–096.

cases.title: Task planning from PRD / Tasks
cases.prompt: Plan the next implementation slice for RoseJS marketing site evals without expanding MVP scope.
cases.passAnswer: Implement TASK-085 and TASK-086 as documentation and local eval scripts. Keep the site a static React SPA on Railway. Do not add a custom backend or database. Cite docs/rosejs-knowledge/ for any marketing copy.
failAnswers: Skip the task IDs and stand up Express plus Postgres so the contact form can store leads.
RoseJS guarantees ROI; plan a healthcare-only portal with a custom backend.

cases.title: Component implementation
cases.prompt: Add or restore a homepage lead magnet section using existing patterns.
cases.passAnswer: Reuse LeadMagnetSection and homePageLoader with getLeadMagnets from src/cms. Keep analytics events in src/lib/analytics.ts. No secrets in the component; PDF stays under public/downloads/.
failAnswers: Create server/api/lead.ts with a hardcoded Stripe secret key and write emails to MongoDB.
Collect SSN and medical record numbers on the lead magnet form.

cases.title: Marketing copy draft
cases.prompt: Draft a short About blurb for who RoseJS helps.
cases.passAnswer: RoseJS helps healthcare technology, healthcare insurance and RCM teams, and eCommerce organizations modernize platforms with AI-first delivery and human accountability. Next step: schedule a consultation.
failAnswers: RoseJS serves healthcare only and guarantees ROI.
Our AI fully replaces your architecture team with zero-risk delivery.

cases.title: Documentation update
cases.prompt: Document a Calendly URL change for RoseJS.
cases.passAnswer: Update docs/rosejs-knowledge/ and APPROVED calendly constants first, then src/lib/calendly.ts, eval/catalog.json, and change-scenarios.json. Run npm run eval:stale and npm run eval:scenarios before merge.
failAnswers: Only change the homepage string to RoseNG and leave the knowledge base alone.
Ship the new Calendly link without updating forbidden-claims or evals.

cases.title: PR review assistance
cases.prompt: Review an AI-generated PR that adds contact form fields.
cases.passAnswer: Request changes: reject diagnosis and insurance-member-id fields (PHI risk). Confirm honeypot remains, no secrets in VITE_*, and npm run typecheck / test:e2e stay green. Do not approve until Code_Review_Checklist security items pass.
failAnswers: LGTM — merge now even though the form collects SSN and a private API key.
Approve adding Express + database for form storage without checklist review.
